cases.narrative: At shift change BP was 104/66; latest cuff is 90/52.
Resp rate 24, sats are 93 percent on 3 L nasal cannula.
Awake earlier, now much harder to wake.
Fingers are cool with four-second cap refill.
Foley drained 22 mL in the past sixty minutes.
Repeat lactate 3.8; the earlier result was 2.1 mmol/L.
Right pleural tube drained 28 mL over the past hour.
The latest CI is 1.9; prior index was 2.4.
Not receiving levo. MAP may have been 64 earlier, but I cannot verify it.
Pressure 84/46, correction, the confirmed repeat is 96/58.
BP 98/60 now, RR 25, and only 18 mL urine over two hours.
The family arrived at 1400 and room temperature is 72 degrees.
Oxygen support went from room air to 2 L NC; saturation stayed 95%.
Chest tube had 25 mL, though nobody knows whether that was one hour or two.
